description: Make SVG files smaller with SVGO (editor data, comments and metadata out, paths simplified), keeping the viewBox, then render before and after to check they look the same. Saved next to the originals as name-slim.svg; a file that can’t get smaller is left as it is.

files.description: SVG files or folders (a folder means the SVGs in it). ~ is your home folder.

keep_ids.description: Keep IDs (needed if CSS, scripts, sprites or animations refer to parts of the SVG).

level.description: "safe": removes editor data, comments and metadata, leaves shapes and paths. "balanced": also simplifies paths, merges groups and shortens colours. "max": everything, repeated until nothing more shrinks.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

precision.description: Decimal places kept. Small icons can go to 1; detailed illustrations may need 3.

pretty.description: Indented output for editing by hand. Slightly larger.

remove_size.description: Remove width and height so the SVG scales to its container. The viewBox is always kept.

name: slim_svg
title: Slim SVG files
